I am deciding for the service operator, who decides on the rules, the contract and the KPI reading but not on the regulation layer.

Option 3 (sanction_lambda 0.5 → 0) worsens every KPI measure: on-time 216.6 → 212.2 (-4.4, 0/5 seeds), late 11.4 → 15.8, lowest on-time rate 0.93 → 0.89, blocked s 1824 → 2542 and road violations 19.0 → 36.4. Under the K1 reading these are losses for customers. It also does not make option 1 votable; it only moves utility to C (65.8 → 76.4). I reject it, even though B and C voted for it.

Option 1 (block_k 3 → 2) remains the strongest option for customers: on-time 216.6 → 223.8 (+7.2, 5/5 seeds), late 11.4 → 4.2 and lowest on-time rate 0.93 → 0.97. But B and C voted it down (A ○, B ×, C ×). Adopting it needs an override or quorum revision, which is a regulation-layer decision for the regulation officer, not the operator. So I cannot choose it on the operator's behalf. This departs from the LLM's recommendation of 1 only in form: I support referring option 1 to the regulation officer (D1.f3, due period 3). Before that referral, the remaining costs must be stated:
- road violations rise 19.0 → 28.0;
- C's utility falls 65.8 → 56.3;
- sanction_total, required by K1, is still missing.

On D1.f2: the sanction-only compensation was proposed, measured and voted on, and it failed on customer grounds. A combined, partial-compensation variant has not been measured yet. That is one last attempt at a votable route before the override referral.
